title: magnetic lacing
text:
I really wanted to LOVE these... really glad I only purchased one to try first. They are very difficult to set. I spent over an hour to "adjust" just one side! The magnets are very strong - good and frustrating. * make sure you keep your two shoes apart while you adjusting because the magnets will marry to the closest magnet. Another hint, set them WAY WAY looser than you think you need. It's easier to tighten in adjustment than to loosen. I initially tried one piece on a different pair of sneakers and because of how the tongue laid, I couldn't use these. So... unlace the magnet and start all over. OH NO! After going through this I feel that having a second person help while you have your shoes on (standing up so you can get the right tight on) would be best in my opinion. They say - you can take them and reuse them over and over again. I want to cry when I think about having to move to another pair! Which brings me to the price. YIKES. I think it would be less disappointing at about 1/2 the price - currently it adds $20 to price of your pair of shoes. So, as long as the pair of shoes I have these currently set on have soles, those magnets are ON. I didn't cut the laces off as suggested just in case I decided NOT to continue - but in all reality laces are fairly cheap. On the other hand, waste not want not. I purchased the white to go on some NB black and white sneakers. It "looks" ok. As for the fit... I am not able to get that nice snug lace fit. The other part of this is that if you try to get them really snug, like you would laces, they will pop right open as that is the magnet's clue you're trying to take them off. You do still need to bend over and attach them together - in case that is an issue for you. And as I said before I highly recommend having a second person help to get the perfect fit. I am so tired of tightening.. OH NO too tight. Readjust... OH NO it's too loose. Over and over again. Having said all that, I can't really recommend these. Sort of like trying to build a better mouse trap I think. I've tried so many of the "no tie" options. So far, this set is one of my least favs due to the very frustrating installation that I can't quite perfect the fit without a second set of hands. Eh. The video makes is look like a breeze, but in my experience, quite a bit more difficult than shown.
UPDATE 5/15/2021 I just purchased something I can't believe is so easy Stretch laces. Works like I had HOPED these would! Tie as you like and leave it tied. They give just a enough to slip them on. NO MORE magnets that snap to each other... no way to comfortably adjust to the right tightness on your foot... you don't need a second person to help adjust to that comfort level... I just tossed the magnets. So glad I only bought one pair.

text: I had ordered this twice now, once in the past and once recently. And both times the sizing was wrong. I did two sizes up on the cup size since the first time it was way off. But the second time the band was way too small. I was insanely annoyed. I think that the bra is definitely no bounce and would be GREAT if you find your size. Personally, not going to bother a third time.

title: Super Cute!
text: These Sperry slip on shoes are super cute! The sizing fits as expected. They seem to be made well. I am expecting them to get dirty quickly, but they are washing machine friendly!

title: True Fit
text: I have been wearing Saucony shoes for a few years now. They're one of the few shoe brands that I can order without trying on first. I can count on their shoes being true fit. This pair is no exception. I have wide feet and it's hard to find shoes that fit period! Let alone being able to order them online. These are running shoes and I am not a runner. I do find them to be less cushiony than I am used to. Maybe it's because they are running shoes. They are still comfortable to wear. I like the black and silver colors.

title: Very Comfy!
text: This is a very comfy bra. The material is so soft! I am a 40DD and this bra fits nicely on me. There is no spillage out of the cups. The straps are adjustable so it provides a decent lift. I would feel fine wearing this at home or to run errands.

title: Great for Layering!
text: My husband is cold natured, so he's always layering clothing in the cooler months. Plain, long sleeved t-shirts are a must for him. This one has a true fit. I ordered his usual large size and it fit as expected. The sleeves are long enough. The material is pretty soft. It will be perfect for the fall and winter seasons!

title: Love It!
text: This is my new favorite sweater! It looks great paired with dark jeans. It's not super soft, but it is soft enough. It's true to size. It hugs my curves without being tight. It's thin enough that I can where my fitted jacket over it. I love it!

title: Nice Looking!
text: I really like the look of these modern sneakers. They are a lot more appropriate for work compared to traditional sneakers. My husband is in his early 50's. He wears khaki pants most days and doesn't wear jeans any more. These go very nicely with his khaki pants! The sizing is good and these fit well. The memory foam and gel add comfort. My husband likes them a lot!

title: Accurate Sizing
text: This is a great lightweight sweater. It's thin enough that you can wear it under a jacket without adding a lot of bulk. The material is not scratchy. The sizing is accurate. I am currently a size 16 women's and it fits nicely. It's a little loose, but it also follows my curves. It's a good addition to my winter wardrobe.

title: Great Fit!
text: My son is a big guy. He is a college student who prefers wearing khakis over jeans. These have a great fit and he finds them comfortable to wear. There's enough stretch in them that they aren't constraining. They seem to have good construction. He's been very pleased with them.

title: Thick Material
text: This is a good quality, men's polo shirt. The material is thicker than a lot of polo shirts. Sizing is as expected. My husband may have been able to get by with a smaller size, but that's often risky, so we round up. He is 6'2" and weighs about 192 pounds. He is really right in the middle between medium and large shirt sizes. It is a little big on him, but not sloppy baggy. The length is good. Overall, it's a nice men's shirt.

title: Great Fit!
text: I was pleasantly surprised with how well these pants fit. They are comfortable and perfect to wear to work. They give a good shape, too. The only thing I would change would be the length. They weren't short by any means, but they were a little shorter than I am used to. I'm 5'6" and usually pants are either a little long or just right. It could have been because they are straight leg rather than boot cut so they hang closer to my leg. It really wasn't a problem, just an observation. I would definitely consider ordering them in another color.

title: My Husband's New Favorite Shirt!
text: My husband is not one to care about brands and logos, but this Under Armour shirt has quickly become his new favorite shirt. He's 6'2 and weighs about 193 pounds. He wears shirts in mediums and larges depending on the fit. This large fits well and is not over sized or baggy on him. It's made well with no construction flaws. The material is light weight and wrinkle resistant. He wears it tucked in with khaki pants and looks like one of the football coaches at the high school where I work at instead of a computer programmer!

title: Nice Fit
text: I currently wear a women's size XL. I hate for my sweaters to be too tight or restricting, so I opted for the 2XL. It fits well without being too baggy. There's enough room for a layer if I wanted to wear something something under it. It's light weight, but not transparent. It is light enough that I need to make sure that I'm not wearing a dark bra with it. The arms are a good length. One of my biggest pet peeves with sweaters is too short of sleeves that have to be pulled at all day long. It's soft, but not the softest sweater I've tried on before. Overall, it's a decent sweater that will be perfect for home or work.

title: Nice Fitting T-Shirt
text: My husband was pleased to have a solid t-shirt without any graphics for a change. He is 6'2" and weighs about 195 pounds right now. He wears t-shirts in the medium to large range. This large shirt fits him fine. It's not baggy on him nor is it tight . The fabric is soft and not the typical dri-fit texture. He really likes it and I've noticed that it's already in his shirt rotation. It washes well and there was no noticeable shrinkage.

title: Cute & Stylish
text: This puffer vest is great for the mild winters we have in Georgia. The medium fits my almost 9 year old niece pretty well. She is below average in size, so it may be a little small on average or above average kids. The jacket is constructed very well. Stitches are secure. Zipper glides smoothly. There are two exterior pockets. It provides adequate warmth and lots of style.
